title: Sunny and the Boobook Owl | Bedtime Story
description: Sonny the Quokka hears a small boobook owl calling from a hollow tree — boo-book, boo-book — soft and steady as a night clock, making the whole bush feel safe and held. A soothing bedtime story for toddlers from Sonny's Cozy Quokka Bedtime Tales.
narration:
Boo-book. Boo-book.

The sound came from high in a hollow gum tree on the rise above the creek.

Sunny stopped walking and listened.

Boo-book. Boo-book.

Two notes. Always two. The same two notes, soft and round, repeated with the patience of someone who had all the time in the world.

She crept closer to the hollow tree and peered up. In the darkness of the hollow, two pale golden eyes were open, watching her calmly.

A boobook owl. Small and round and perfectly still.

His feathers were dark brown, spotted with cream. He sat so tidily in his hollow that he looked like he had been placed there especially.

Boo-book. Boo-book.

He called again without moving. Just the sound, rising from him like something natural, like breathing.

Sunny sat down at the base of the tree and leaned against the bark.

The call went on. Boo-book. Boo-book.

It was the most reliable sound in the bush. Every few seconds, without fail. Steady. Soft. Present.

Sunny began to count the calls. One. Two. Three. Four...

She lost count somewhere around twelve. Her head had nodded forward. Her paws had relaxed in her lap.

The owl kept calling. The night kept passing.

Boo-book. Boo-book.

Goodnight, Sunny. Goodnight, boobook owl. Goodnight, little one.
